newsitem.title: USA: Waxman says tobacco papers suggest industry fraud.
newsitem.headline: Waxman says tobacco papers suggest industry fraud.

text.p: A leading congressional anti-smoking crusader on Thursday released some confidential industry documents that he said suggest the tobacco industry and its lawyers may have schemed to "defraud and deceive" the public for decades.

Rep. Henry Waxman, a California Democrat, made public a handful of the thousands of confidential Liggett and Myers Tobacco Co. documents which he said show disturbing patterns of "potentially criminal or fraudulent conduct" by the industry.
